This makes the study of a relational profile critical from an application point of view and provides rich information about individuals’ social profile.

### 2.2. Attachment Orientations in Online Social Networks

Attachment orientations, a key individual difference of relational orientation, can be derived on the basis of traces found in micro-blogs. Attachment orientations capture one’s notion of the self in relation to others and interpersonal relationships, with attachment theory being one of the key personality theoretical frames to explain actual social behavior [31].
